decisions.name: Suining
decisions.reason: The original UN WUP 2025 archive has separate 2025 Suining records: code 10768 at rank 2501, [33.9010628899826, 117.957401441094], 234397 persons, and code 7988 at [30.511307967251, 105.580153252327], 613678 persons. Their settlement points are 1223.04 km apart. The earlier completed packet and registry row identify only wup2025:7988. The shared romanized name does not make that packet a prior attempt on 10768. Move the unchanged WUP10768 row into pending research; its registry custody, public parcel geometry and runtime qualification remain unresolved.

evidence.observation: Verbatim original UN WUP rows, archive hash and prior packet scope.
Immutable rank 2501 roster identity, point and population.
Previous Suining investigation explicitly binds WUP code 7988.
Previous checked registry row is keyed to wup2025:7988.

scope: Prior-attempt identity only; no parcel custody, public geometry, citywide absence or runtime-admission conclusion for WUP10768.
